publishedSpecs.Both models offer a dual-mounting system: PCB gasket mount and isolated top mount, with silicone gaskets around the mounting screws to eliminate metal-to-metal rattling.
publishedSpecs.Three PCB options are available: Tri-mode Hotswap (USB-C/BT/2.4GHz), Wired Hotswap, and Solder PCB. All PCBs are 1.6mm thick without flex cuts and are VIA-compatible with no per-key RGB.
